findings.title: Projects badge silently drops cost-center filter
findings.problem: The project_count column always renders a ResourceCounterBadge link to Project Management with cost_center_ids set, but Project Management only honors cost_center_ids when the visiting user is admin or maintainer (canFilterByCostCenter in ProjectsManagementFull.tsx:221-222); the Cost Centers route itself has no role gate, only a COST_CENTERS FeatureGuard, so any authenticated user with the feature flag on can reach this badge.
findings.impact: A non-admin/non-maintainer user clicking the badge lands on the full, unfiltered Project Management list with no indication the expected filter was dropped, making the new navigation feature silently misleading for that audience.
findings.recommendation: Gate the link the same way the destination page does (reuse the isAdmin/isMaintainer check) and render a plain, non-link count — matching the badge's pre-change behavior — when the viewer cannot filter by cost center.
